on_effect: When a mission script calls SquadronSetForceRelease(squadron, on), the new dispatch row stores the flag on the squadron's slot. Every level-bomb plane of that squadron then reads it: the aim tick's close test (009B5DC3) and steer (009B63EE), and 009B88F0's aim transition. That transition now runs the 009B7B10 and 009B7B40 bodies over aim+18h/+19h and the byte. A forced squadron releases (kRelease) where an unforced one aborts (kGoAway). No script in scripts/ or universe/ of this installation calls SquadronSetForceRelease (grep), so with this installation's missions the byte stays 0 and the transitions match OFF.
off_preservation: OFF arms are the original code: the inline predicates in 009B88F0 and the literal false at both host sites. The OFF base of GameUnitSlot is empty, so the slot layout is unchanged. The dispatch row is constant-false OFF, and the new setter and handler are never called. The raw 009B7B10 and 009B7B40 entries forward to the typed views with the same tests in the same order (the squadron byte is read only on the path the listing reads it). No host path calls them.
